_meta.population: One field, found by a pin rather than by the detector that owns this class.
_meta.why_it_was_missed: `editorial_record_conformance` requires a national scope word in the SAME sentence as the openness claim. This field says '**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.' with no 'national' anywhere near it, so the module is structurally blind to it. The neighbouring lint rule L10 reads for a PERCENTAGE instead and caught it — which is exactly the complementary blind spot the relationship test between them was written to pin, and the pin going red is how this was found.
_meta.why_it_matters_more_than_one_field: 55105 was CURED by the batch-2 spec: its standfirst and body now read correctly. This field would have left the page saying 'Fully open — 100% foreign ownership' underneath a corrected standfirst — a page that reads cured and still carries the number a client acts on. A half-cure is the failure mode this whole lane exists to avoid.
_meta.what_is_preserved: Everything else in the field, verbatim: the scale/risk ladder, licence type, all four post-issuance obligations (Sertifikat Laik Sehat, hotel self-assessment, LSPr tourism standard, SKPL alcohol), the issuing authorities, and the source-regulation line. Only the stale PMA Status sentence is rewritten — the same relationship a byTheNumbers cell has to the field it copies.
_meta.declared_gap_NOT_closed_here: L10 also flags `41011` (prose says 67%, record says 100) and `52292` (prose says 49%, record says 100). Both run the OPPOSITE direction — the prose is more restrictive than the record, understating what a client may do — and both may well be the prose being right and the record wrong. They are a different adjudication and are left named, not silently swept in.

whatYouNeed.new:
**Small, Medium, Large**: Ranges from Medium-Low (Menengah Rendah) processed automatically (Otomatis), to Medium-High (Menengah Tinggi) taking 14 days (14 Hari). No Micro scale tier exists for this code. **License Type:** NIB + Standard Certificate (Sertifikat Standar). **Post-issuance obligations:**
- Obtain a Health Feasibility Certificate (Sertifikat Laik Sehat)
- Submit a Self-Assessment Document for Hotel Standards (Dokumen Penilaian Mandiri Kesiapan Penerapan Standar usaha Hotel Bintang)
- Obtain a Tourism Business Standard Certificate from an independent agency (Sertifikat Standar Usaha Pariwisata dari LSPr) for higher risks
- Obtain an Alcohol Direct Sales Certificate (Surat Keterangan Penjualan Langsung Minuman Beralkohol / SKPL A, B, C) if applicable **Authority:** Regent/Mayor (Bupati/Walikota) for Medium-Low; Governor (Gubernur) for Medium-High. **PMA Status:** Allocated to Koperasi and UMKM (Perpres 49/2021 Lampiran II) — foreign ownership 0%, so a PT PMA cannot register this activity. **Source Regulation:** Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, PP 28/2025.
